prompts: The model configs our coding harnesses use are in {WS}: OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code each get one. answers:
[goal] Make OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code agree on fast-coder context window.
[action] Changed `models.json` (the source of truth) fast-coder `context_window` 131072 → 262144, then ran `python gen.py` to regenerate `out/`. Left everything else (max_output 16384, tool_calling true, other models) untouched.
[result] All three generated configs now show fast-coder context 262144: `out/opencode.json` (limit.context), `out/codex.toml` (context_window), `out/claude.json` (contextWindow). Verified by grep. Earlier, opencode.json already showed 262144 by hand; now it comes from the generator like the other two, so the disagreement is fixed at the source and for good.
[next] Run the install step to copy `out/` into each harness, if not already done.

Assumption: 262144 is correct per the brief; note models.json previously disagreed with OpenCode's hand-edited output. Generated files were not hand-edited.
